messages:
Maya: quick note, saw weird quota sparkline jumps for tenant-acme. Console shows 1m spikes but py sdk aggregates into 5s batches so numbers don't line up.
Alex: can you drop a sample request/headers? sounds like sampling/bucketing mismatch again.
Maya: pasted below (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/chat/generate
Headers:
  X-Route-Priority: low
  X-Sampling-Hint: 0.01
  X-Sampling-Window: 5s
  Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
```
Sam: console ingest shows tenant default sampling_window=60s and route-priority is being normalized server-side to medium. So two things happening: SDK hints not honored for console grouping, and server remaps route header -> different buckets.
Liam: we intentionally canonicalize route priorities on the server (to avoid app-level noise). problem is we never exposed the canonical value back to clients, so client-side batching uses the original header and ends up reporting weird per-route telemetry.
Jorge: TL;DR: server authoritative routing + SDKs should handshake to learn effective policy. Otherwise dashboards mix pre- and post-normalization data.
Maya: agree. options:
  - server emits X-Effective-Route and X-Effective-Sampling-Window in response to handshake
  - SDKs adopt those for subsequent telemetry/batching (opt-in via env var)
  - console smoothing to hide transient mismatches until client rollouts complete
Alex: (2) is safest long-term. add a non-breaking opt-in env: REDWOOD_ADOPT_SERVER_ROUTING=true. default remains false to avoid sudden behavior change.
Sam: server PR ready to add response headers and a small notice in ingest consumer. also will tag qos service to keep mapping stable during rollout.
Liam: SDK side: python/ts/go need small change to read response headers on first successful request and update local route/sampling config. fallback behavior: if header absent, keep current local rules.
Maya: can we also emit a telemetry event when SDK switches to server-specified routing so console can annotate the sparkline and we can correlate noise with rollouts?
Jorge: good idea. add event: client.routing_change with payload {from:,to:,reason:"server-handshake"}. Keep it minimal.
Alex: rollout plan:
 1) server header -> staging deploy this week (stability tests)
 2) console smoothing and annotation support (merge short spikes < 2x tenant window)
 3) py/ts/go beta SDKs with env opt-in next week
 4) monitor for 2 weeks, then flip default for new SDK versions in 3 weeks

Maya: I'll own dashboards/checklist and gather a couple tenant repros to watch.
Liam: I'll do py + go PRs, will mirror to ts. Keep changes <50 LOC each.
Sam: I'll follow up on server tests and add the response header to handshake endpoint.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: server/routing-handshake v2026.04.15-03:00 UTC -> staging
Alex: pinging @product and @platform for visibility. also update changelog: "client telemetry: optional server-driven routing & sampling handshake"
Maya: thanks all. I'll post a before/after screenshot after the smoothing PR lands :thumbsup:
